experiment: K54: Fama-French 5-Factor + Momentum + BAB Controls for VT Alpha
description: Paper 3 requirement: Test whether VT alpha survives after controlling for FF5+MOM+BAB. Uses actual FF factor data from Kenneth French's library + ETF-based BAB proxy.

models.M3: α + β_MKT × MKT + β_TSMOM × TSMOM_orth + SMB + HML + RMW + CMA

Q1_alpha_survives.question: Does VT alpha survive after FF5+MOM+BAB?

Q2_TSMOM_vs_MOM.question: Does TSMOM loading survive after MOM control? (TSMOM ≠ cross-sectional MOM)
Q2_TSMOM_vs_MOM.conclusion: TSMOM β=0.1228 (t=8.67) after MOM control. MOM β=-0.0131 (t=-1.59). TSMOM 存活 — TSMOM ≠ cross-sectional MOM

Q3_BAB_absorption.question: Does BAB absorb VT alpha? (VT involves dynamic leverage)
Q3_BAB_absorption.conclusion: BAB β=-0.0217 (t=-3.31). Alpha 從 1.35% → 1.28%/yr. BAB 吸收部分 alpha

Q4_variance_decomposition.question: Which factors explain most VT variance?
